test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

Rina told Suman to leave the city immediately.

options.text: Rina said to Suman, "Leave the city immediately now."
Rina said to Suman, "Please leave the city immediately."
Rina said to Suman, "Leave the city immediately."
Rina said to Suman, "You leave the city immediately."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Rina told Suman to leave the city immediately.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Rina told Suman to leave" becomes "Rina said to Suman, 'Leave"**
 
 
• The reporting verb "told" is converted to "said to" in direct speech.
 
• The command "to leave" is converted to the imperative "Leave".
 
 
 
• **"the city immediately" remains unchanged**
 
 
• The phrase "the city immediately" is directly used as it is in both indirect and direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• The command starts with a capital letter "Leave" and ends with a period "." inside the quotation marks.
 
• The reporting clause precedes the quoted speech, separated by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rina said to Suman, 'Leave the city immediately.'"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Rina said to Suman, 'Leave the city immediately now.'"

 
 
• The word "now" is redundant as "immediately" already conveys the urgency.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Rina said to Suman, 'Please leave the city immediately.'"
 
 
• The addition of "please" changes the tone from a command to a polite request.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Rina said to Suman, 'You leave the city immediately.'"
 
 
• The addition of "You" is unnecessary and alters the concise command form.
